title: Mega's Pigsteel
description: Pigsteel is a new material obtainable in the Nether and an upgrade to Netherite with new custom powerful Weapons
body:
![Pigsteel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9e78c571707869e006c8a28cc81aeb6407d0b8b.png)
Pigsteel is a mod that adds a new endgame material for making tools, Armor and Weapons this material is an upgrade to Netherite it can be obtained in the Nether from Bastion Remnants and can be used to make awesome new pig themed weapons
![Pigsteel Ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33347a3c450f436076795f73cdf7771411454224.png)
